$comment: Hand-labeled from the pinned sample source: every rpc of examples/protos (10 rpcs in 5 services) with its messages and streaming kind, and the C++ methods that implement it (service impl classes deriving from the generated Service or CallbackService; the async server examples use the generated AsyncService and implement no method). There is no generated Go interface, so served is null. Build targets: the CMake files of helloworld and route_guide (the foreach loops over executable names expanded by hand; links to imported targets such as absl::check and gRPC::grpc++ are not labeled, the generated protobuf sources of the *_grpc_proto libraries are not in the scan). The two Makefiles are labeled too: the executables of the `all` target with the .cc files of their .o prerequisites (the generated *.pb.cc are not in the scan). Calls: every call whose callee is a function or method of this repository in route_guide_server.cc, route_guide_client.cc, route_guide_callback_server.cc, helper.cc, greeter_server.cc and greeter_client.cc, labeled with its definition (checked by searching each in-repository function name in the six files); calls into gRPC, protobuf and the C++ library are not labeled. A call through a generated stub (stub_->SayHello, stub_->GetFeature) runs the service implementations, which are its targets, one per implementing class.
